meta.name: Combat visuals manifest
meta.purpose: Maps combat context (and, from ticket 09, enemy/ally template key) to the art asset that renders it, so scenes/screens/combat.gd never hardcodes a path. See docs/combat-animation-vision.md §2.1/§6 and docs/ART-BIBLE.md.
meta.backdropRule: One entry per Combat.CANONICAL_CONTEXTS context (systems/combat.gd). 'image' is a res:// path to a 390x360 backdrop plate, or "" when no plate has been produced yet -- the stage then fills with the flat data/palette.json colour named by 'fallbackColor' instead.
